kebab_example: aliyun iotcc list-service --iot-cloud-connector-id iotcc-bp1odcab8tmno0hdq0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListService

parameters.help_en: List of application statistics service IDs
parameters.name: service_ids

parameters.help_en: A list of service names, grouped by application
parameters.help_zh: 分应用统计服务名称列表
parameters.name: service_names

parameters.help_en: List the statuses of service resources by application
parameters.help_zh: 分应用统计服务资源状态列表
parameters.name: resource_statuses

parameters.help_en:
Whether a token exists for the next query. Values:

Do not enter a value for the first query or if no next query exists.

If a next query exists, the value is the NextToken returned by the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries displayed per paged query. Value range: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID where the application statistics service is located.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html API to get the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
分应用统计服务所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/313836.html接口获取地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

MaxResults.description_en: The number of entries displayed per paged query
MaxResults.description_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数

NextToken.description_en:
Whether a token exists for the next query. Values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.

If NextToken has a return value, it indicates the token for the start of the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

ServiceDescription.description_en:
Description of the application statistics service.

The length is 2 to 256 characters. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase English letter. However, it cannot be `http://` or `https://`
ServiceDescription.description_zh:
分应用统计服务的描述。

长度为2~256个字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，但不能为`http://`或`https://`

ServiceId.description_en: The system-generated ID for the application statistics service, unique across the entire network
ServiceId.description_zh: 系统为分应用统计服务生成的ID，全网唯一

ServiceName.description_en:
The name of the application statistics service.

The length is 2 to 128 characters. It must start with an uppercase or lowercase English letter. It can contain numbers, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
ServiceName.description_zh:
分应用统计服务的名称。

长度为2~128个英文或中文字符，开头必须为大小写英文字母或中文，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

ServiceStatus.description_en:
The status of the service resource. Values:

Creating: Creating.

Created: Created.

Deleting: Deleting.

Updating: Updating
ServiceStatus.description_zh:
服务资源的状态。取值：
Creating：创建中。
Created：已创建。
Deleting：删除中。
Updating：更新中
